title: Introducing Yourself
label: ch:introductions
canDo: I can introduce myself in French, give my name, and understand the other person's name.

payoff.summary: Now a first real exchange — “Je m'appelle Mira.” / “Comment vous appelez-vous?” / “Je m'appelle Arun.” / “Enchanté.” — giving your name, asking for someone else's, and saying you are glad to meet them. We build it the same way as the greetings: each piece taken apart first, then assembled.
payoff.note: Chapter 2 is schema-v2 as of the hand-written-chapter retirement, so the payoff is atom-scored: FR-C02-practice assesses every atom the chapter introduces. Two of the twelve carry a suffix that keeps them clear of an id a later chapter already owns — FR-LEX-COMMENT-HOW-10 beside chapter 32's FR-LEX-COMMENT-05, which types comment as one of the five question words, and FR-GRAM-INVERSION-NAME-11 beside chapter 32's FR-GRAMMAR-INVERSION-08.
